title: action.plan.created
description: PAYLOAD of the `action.plan.created` envelope. Topic: activation.action_plan.created. Emitted by the Ledger (§7.4) when a new ActionPlan is PROPOSED (status=proposed) — before any signature or execution. Carries the full Explanation (P5: no silent actions — every autonomous action emits an Explanation BEFORE execution). The plan body is the frozen artifact action_plan.schema.json (§7.4, P5). This event references it + its hash-chain position. NOTHING mutates a platform on this event — that needs action.plan.signed -> action.executed (P4).

action_plan_id.description: Ledger id of the ActionPlan (matches action_plan.schema.json id).

action_type.description: What the plan will do once signed+executed. The connector mutation it authorizes (P4 — executor-only).

target_ref.description: The entity the action targets, form platform:entity:id (e.g. meta:ad:123) or an internal ref. Matches Appendix-A optimization.decision.platform_ref shape.

status.description: Lifecycle status at creation = proposed (§7.4 status enum). Signing flips it via action.plan.signed.

explanation.description: The mandatory Explanation (P5, §7.4). Plain-language + vernacular why, with evidence. NO action without this. Mirrors Appendix-A optimization.decision.explanation.

evidence.description: The facts justifying the action (every action cites evidence §7.4/P5).

approval_required.description: Driven by Approval Policy + autopilot level (§17.1).

budget_governor_stamp.description: Required for any spend-changing plan to be signable (§13.1 — every spend-changing ActionPlan needs a Governor stamp). Absent for non-spend actions.

prev_hash.description: Hash-chain link to the previous Ledger entry (§5.5 tamper-evident append-only).

hash.description: Hash of this Ledger entry (over content + prev_hash).
